rows: Characteristic energy = v∞² = excess kinetic energy at departure; C3 = 0 means just barely escaping Earth; C3 > 0 means you have velocity to spare at infinity; determines how much launch vehicle capability is needed
Contour map of C3 (or mission ΔV) vs launch date and arrival date; shows which launch dates offer efficient trajectories; "pork chop" shape identifies launch windows
Why do missions use gravity assists?
To gain or lose orbital energy without propellant; equivalent to many km/s of free ΔV at the cost of flight time and additional trajectory complexity
Sphere of Influence: the region where a body's gravity dominates over the Sun's; inside SOI, trajectory is approximately a conic section around that body
What is the "7 minutes of terror" for Mars?
Time from atmospheric entry to landing for Curiosity/Perseverance; no real-time control possible (7-20 min radio delay); fully autonomous EDL sequence
Multiple shallow passes through a planet's upper atmosphere to reduce orbital energy; saves enormous propellant; used by multiple Mars orbiters
What tracking measurement gives the best range accuracy?
Range measurement (time-of-flight); Doppler gives best velocity accuracy; VLBI gives angular position; all three combined for full orbit determination
